title: HomeFlood Rate Manual — Base Rates and Rating Factor Tables
content:
Tidemark's filed rate manual for **HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies** sets the following base rates and rating factor tables.

## Base annual rates (USD per 100 USD of coverage)

| Tier | Dwelling | Personal property |
|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Renters | 0 | 0.55 |
| HomeFlood Essential | 0.38 | 0.48 |
| HomeFlood Standard | 0.42 | 0.50 |
| HomeFlood Plus | 0.46 | 0.58 |
| HomeFlood Premier | 0.49 | 0.61 |
| HomeFlood Estate | 0.52 | 0.63 |

## Zone factor table (all tiers)

| FEMA flood zone | Factor |
|---|---|
| X, B, C | 0.35 |
| D | 1.1 |
| A99, AR | 0.65 |
| A, AE, AH | 1.0 |
| AO | 0.95 |
| V, VE | 2.4 |

## Elevation factor table (all tiers)

The row is chosen by whole feet of the lowest floor above (plus) or below (minus) the base flood elevation.

| Lowest floor relative to base flood elevation | Factor |
|---|---|
| +4 feet or more | 0.35 |
| +3 | 0.45 |
| +2 | 0.58 |
| +1 | 0.75 |
| 0 | 1.0 |
| -1 | 1.4 |
| -2 feet or lower | 1.95 |

## Elevation factors where the table is not used (all tiers)

| Situation | Factor |
|---|---|
| Property in a Special Flood Hazard Area without an accepted Elevation Certificate showing a base flood elevation | 1.25 |
| Property outside a Special Flood Hazard Area | 1.0 |

## Deductible factor table (all tiers)

| Deductible (USD) | 500 | 1000 | 1500 | 2000 | 2500 | 5000 | 10000 | 25000 | 50000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Factor | 1.04 | 1.0 | 0.97 | 0.94 | 0.92 | 0.85 | 0.77 | 0.66 | 0.57 |

## Elevation Certificate age

The oldest Elevation Certificate survey date accepted for rating, when the building has not been altered since the survey, is 10 years on every tier.

*Hypothetical lookup:* a HomeFlood Premier dwelling limit of 500,000 USD at 0.49 per 100 USD gives a dwelling rate amount of 5,000 hundreds multiplied by 0.49, that is 2,450 USD, before any factor.
